records.english: {SPEAKER:04}This is no ordinary tablet. There's no local stone, so even the mosques use dried mud.{PAD}
records.speaker: Janus Pasha
records.context: Lil finds a stone tablet; Janus explains that local mosques use mud because stone is scarce.
records.source_meaning: This is no ordinary tablet. There is no stone in this area; that is why they build mosques from dried mud.
records.localization_note: Reviewed against clean Japanese and adjacent tablet dialogue for Lil and Janus's voices.

records.speaker: Lil Argot
records.context: Lil finds a stone tablet; Janus explains that local mosques use mud because stone is scarce.
records.source_meaning: Does that mean this tablet was not made here?

records.speaker: Janus Pasha
records.context: Lil finds a stone tablet; Janus explains that local mosques use mud because stone is scarce.

records.speaker: Scene sound
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Whispering...
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:B4}This is bad. We can't get near it...{PAD}
records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: This is trouble. We cannot touch that now...
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Were you the bandits who attacked Sao Jorge?{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Were you the bandits attacking Sao Jorge?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: What?! Who are you?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: I'm with FO.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97. Preserves the FO runtime faction macro with Lil's route-level expansion parity.

records.english: {SPEAKER:B4}What?! You helped guard that town! You've ruined everything!{PAD}
records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: What?! You helped guard that town and caused us enormous trouble!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Because of you, we cannot raid it! You've ruined our livelihood!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: Bold words for bandits! We can't abandon a town in need!{PAD}
records.speaker: Continuing companion
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Bold words for bandits! We cannot abandon a town in need!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97. The source-leading LF is staging; English begins on the first row without a speaker byte.

records.english: {SPEAKER:B4}Shut up! Those Europeans destroyed our village!{PAD}
records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Shut up! Those Europeans destroyed our village!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: No matter what anyone says, we will have revenge!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Wait. Your enemies are corrupt slavers and brutal soldiers who ravage Africa.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Wait. The only people you should resent are the corrupt slave traders and brutal soldiers plundering Africa.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Attack Europeans indiscriminately, and you're no better than those brutes. Just as guilty.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: If you hate every European and attack indiscriminately, you are no better than those cruel people. Equally guilty.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: You talk as if you know!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Give up revenge. That will never restore your happiness.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Give up revenge. It's meaningless; it cannot restore your happiness, can it?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}That will only start another fight. More of your people will suffer.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: That only causes more fighting. More of your people will suffer.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:B4}Then what are we supposed to do?!{PAD}
records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Then what are we supposed to do?!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Europe's struggle for power fuels conflicts on every sea. We must end that struggle.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: End the struggle for influence between European countries that causes countless conflicts across the world's seas.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Great powers plan to carve up our world. Their excuse is the Proofs. We gather them to stop those plans.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: The great powers are about to divide the world. We collect the Proofs of Supremacy they seek as a pretext, to prevent this.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Stop the great powers?! Are you sane?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}This is no bluff. Our influence reaches Africa now. We're strong enough to meet them on equal terms, or better.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: This is no bluff. Our influence reaches Africa now, and we're confident we can meet them on equal terms or better.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Why not trust us with your revenge?{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Well? Why not entrust that revenge to us?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: What?!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:03}Come to sea with us. With that spirit, you can make it.{PAD}
records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Come to sea with us. With such spirit, you can surely succeed.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Nothing will change if we stay here...
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: All right. We'll bet on you!
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: Welcome.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.english: {SPEAKER:B4}We found this hidden in the ruins. Could it be tied to your Proof?{PAD}
records.speaker: African raider
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: I don't know if this relates to the Proof you seek, but this was hidden in the ruins.
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.

records.speaker: Maria
records.context: Shared Maria branch: African raiders explain their revenge; Maria recruits them against the great powers.
records.source_meaning: A stone tablet...?
records.localization_note: Shared Maria branch confirmed by source-identical SC0 B123, SC1 B123, and SC3 B97.
